items.title: Unit 7 · Story
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.storyText: The sun is up! Hi! This is my uncle. He is a vet. Do you have a cat? No, I don't. What is that? It is a small tiger!
items.why: In “Story 7”, you hear: The sun is up! The missing word is “sun”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 1, Unit 7, p.73 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
